title: Aging Schedule: Age of the Named Posting and the Hardship Waiver Share
content:
| Age of the named posting, calendar days from its posting date to today | Age share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 90 | 0.8 |
| 91 to 180 | 0.9 |
| 181 or more | 1 |

**Rule.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, the age share of a hardship waiver is 0.8 when the named posting was posted within the last 90 calendar days, 0.9 when it was posted 91 to 180 days ago, and 1 when it is older.

Before the ceilings and the rounding apply, the waiver — the waivable cost share less the balance adjustments already posted against the named posting — is multiplied by the age share.

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical waivable cost share of 60.00)**

- Posted 90 days ago: 48.00. Posted 91 days ago: 54.00.
- Posted 180 days ago: 54.00. Posted 181 days ago: 60.00.
